description: This Java source file defines a custom ListView subclass called ExpandingListView that supports expandable/collapsible list items with animated transitions. It handles user interactions to expand or collapse individual list items, manages animations for smooth UI updates, and maintains views that temporarily disappear during animations.

classes.name: ExpandingListView
classes.description: A custom ListView subclass that provides animated expanding and collapsing cells, supporting extra content preview on item click with smooth animations and view management during state transitions.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the list view by setting up the item click listener.

methods.name: getTopAndBottomTranslations
methods.description: Calculates the translation values for top and bottom bounds of list items when expanding or collapsing, adjusting for list boundaries and item positions.

methods.name: expandView
methods.description: Handles the expansion animation of a clicked list item, including layout updates, view translations, and animated effects for smooth transition.

methods.name: collapseView
methods.description: Handles the collapse animation of a clicked list item, reversing the expansion effect with animated bounds and content visibility changes.

methods.name: getAnimation
methods.description: Creates an ObjectAnimator for transitioning the 'top' and 'bottom' bounds of a view during expand/collapse animations.

methods.name: dispatchDraw
methods.description: Overrides drawing to render views that are off-screen during animations, ensuring visual continuity.
